aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1 (p.2): 'A light weigh self-compacting geopolymer concrete may be useful for a varaiety of applications such as new construction or retrofitting'; Sec.6.2: 'especially for light weight applications and the precast industry' (estudo de laboratorio, sem aplicacao concreta declarada)
nota: Nenhuma vida util (propria ou citada) no artigo; 'durability' so aparece como propriedade generica e em titulos de referencias.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3 (caso 1): 'The carbon reduction effect of the traditional reinforced concrete footbridge and the 3D printed footbridge is evaluated...'; 'The bridge panel is 0.5 m thick and prefabricated in the factory ... C30 concrete'; 'the abutment material uses C40 reinforced concrete'
nota: O corpo do artigo nao contem nenhuma ocorrencia de 'year'/'service life'/'lifespan'; fronteira = fase de materializacao (construcao) da ponte pedonal; fases de operacao/manutencao excluidas explicitamente.

declarada.citacao: Sec.3 (p.3): 'Eurocode 2 stipulates that the minimum concrete cover must satisfy both bond and durability requirements. Thus, considering a projected service life of 50 years, an exposure class of XC3/XC4 ..., the minimum concrete cover recommended is 40 mm.'

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.4.1: '1 m3 of reinforced concrete ... is assumed to be a sub-section of a larger concrete structure'; Sec.3: 'both concrete structures were assumed to be situated outdoors and subjected to cyclic wet and dry conditions' (sem tipo de obra declarado)
nota: Valor gravado (50) confirmado. Os 50 anos so servem para o recobrimento pelo EC2; o estudo acaba por adoptar o recobrimento mais conservador da ACI 318-14 (50/40 mm) e a ACV e cradle-to-gate (a vida util nao entra na unidade funcional).

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.1: 'UHPC has been progressively finding applications in a wide range of structures, such as railway sleepers..., tramway stations..., and bridges' (so contexto geral do UHPC; o estudo e de laboratorio sobre auto-sensoriamento, sem aplicacao propria)
Titulo/resumo: 'quantify GHG emissions from recycled concrete used for pavements'; Sec.1: 'Using recycled concrete for pavement construction is a sustainable practice...'
nota: Confirmado: nenhuma vida util no corpo. So menciona 'carbonation during its service life'/'pavement's service life' sem numero; o '100 year' aparece apenas no titulo de Pade & Guimaraes (2007) na lista de referencias (horizonte de captura de CO2, nao vida util).

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.4: 'evaluate the life cycle impact assessment of the industrial production of a greener building material (i.e. the Geopolymer Concrete - GC) than the Conventional Concrete (CC)' (sem aplicacao estrutural declarada; CC de 20 MPa do Ecoinvent como comparador)
nota: Unicos periodos no artigo: 220 dias/ano de producao e 10 anos de duracao do investimento (NPV) - nao sao vida util do betao.

declarada.citacao: Sec.3.2 (p.116): 'The functional unit is defined to be a building structural system including foundations ... with a 60-year lifetime.'

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo: 'compare the climate change impact (CC) of a reinforced concrete (RC) benchmark structure ... for four buildings ranging from 3 to 21 storeys'
nota: Valor gravado (60) confirmado; aplica-se aos dois pares (950, 951). Os 60 anos tambem sao o periodo de armazenamento usado no GWPbio (ref. [25]) e o periodo de carbonatacao 'during building lifetime'.

citadas.fonte: [14] Huberman & Pearlmutter, A life-cycle energy analysis of building materials in the Negev desert, Energy Build. 40 (2008) 837-848
citadas.citacao: Sec.1 (p.146-147): 'the use of alternative materials, such as mortar/concrete blocks, stabilized soil blocks or fly-ashes instead of materials with high embodied energy content, like reinforced concrete, could cut cumulative energy by 20% over a building's 50-year life cycle [14]'

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.5: 'four types of load-bearing wall: ... reinforced concrete-based wall (RC) ... We evaluated a three-storey building whose total height is 9.90 m'
nota: O estudo inclui manutencao/reparacao e demolicao mas nao declara nenhum periodo de vida util. A unica vida util citada e o ciclo de vida de 50 anos de um edificio (generico, edificio inteiro) - fraca, avaliar se conta.

aplicacao_citacao: Resumo: 'ordinary portland cement (OPC) structural concrete elements in building-related LCAs'; Sec.2.2.1: unidade funcional = 'a three-meter-tall concrete column ... to resist a 3000 kN force'
nota: Valor gravado (25) confirmado, mas e um periodo de exposicao a carbonatacao (cenario finito, ao lado de um cenario 'infinito'), sem fonte; nao e vida util de projecto da estrutura. A aplicacao 'edificio' vem do enquadramento do artigo (LCA de edificios, pilar de 3 m), nao de um edificio concreto.
